methods.notes: Preferred. Scoped roles enforced by APIKeyFilter; insufficient role returns 403 with JSON OperationResponse. Only valid on /api paths.
Full account credentials; username/password must not contain ':'. SSO users must use API keys instead.

auth.noAuthMode: If the instance runs with EnableAuth=false, every request is treated as root; credentials are ignored (source: Middleware/Authen.cs).
auth.apiEnableToggle: NONE. There is no 'enable API' setting; /api is always routed. (source: Program.cs, Authen.cs)
auth.unauthenticated401: API-path 401 responses have an EMPTY body with WWW-Authenticate: Basic; non-API paths redirect (302) to /Login/Index. (source: Authen.cs HandleChallengeAsync)

conventions.invariantHeader: Send header 'culture-invariant' (presence only, no value) => dates serialize as yyyy-MM-dd, numerics as JSON numbers, booleans as JSON booleans. Without it everything is a locale-formatted string. (docs + source: TypeConverter.cs, StaticHelper.GetInvariantOption)
conventions.dateInput: Body/query dates parsed with server-culture DateTime.Parse; ISO yyyy-MM-dd is unambiguous in every .NET culture and is what the node always sends. Unix epoch seconds also accepted for JSON number date fields (source: FromDateOptional.Read).
conventions.postPutEncoding: JSON (Consumes application/json), form-data, or x-www-form-urlencoded. Node uses JSON.
conventions.mutationEnvelope: Mutations return OperationResponse { success: bool, message: string, data?: object }. add returns data.recordId (data.vehicleId for vehicles). GETs return bare arrays/objects.
conventions.updateIsFullReplace: CONFIRMED DATA-LOSS HAZARD (source: every API update handler): update replaces the entire record. Omitted extraFields, files, tags, notes are overwritten with empty values. The node therefore does read-merge-write on update.
conventions.pagination: NONE on any endpoint. Controllers materialize the full record list and filter in memory (source: all API controllers). Node offers client-side limit only.
conventions.errorShape: Failures return OperationResponse JSON with 400/403/500. 401 is empty-bodied. Unknown paths and reverse-proxy errors can return HTML; the node detects non-JSON bodies.
conventions.units: Odometer/fuel-volume units are the instance's configured units (Use Imperial Calculation / Use UK MPG Calculation user settings). NOT exposed by /api/info (source: ServerInformation.cs = version, locale, currencySymbol, decimalSeparator, dateFormat only). The node does not convert units.
conventions.webhooks: LubeLogger DOES have an outgoing webhook (single server-wide URL set manually in Server Settings) and a SignalR WebSocket at /api/ws. Neither is API-registrable per workflow, so the trigger node polls. (docs: Advanced/Webhook.md; source: Logic/Event)
